# Dan's TC production fixtures

These are minimal decoded fields extracted from Dan/Shazama's actual games.
No production state, timing, queue or progress was generated by a mock. Numeric
wire fields are recorded by their schema names and decoded back to real Nodes
in `test_building_activity.py`.

- `dan-tc-research-housed.json.gz`: 430 real samples, game 7:10.001–10:44.501,
  from `live-20261111-224438-12.vrec`, a replay of Dan's November 11 game.
  Its recording header points to `rec.aoe2record` in the real AoE2 DE Steam
  prefix. TC 9129 researches age tech 101, then trains villagers, then waits
  for housing with a villager queued and no current action. Villagers created
  rise from 19 to 22 and tech 101 completes. The window adds zero idle time.
- `dan-tc-handoff.json.gz`: 40 samples, 4:00.045–4:19.543, from the real game
  capture `live-20261110-190527-3.vrec`. TC 7724's current action disappears
  for one sample between villagers while the next unit remains queued. This
  window also adds zero idle time.

Each fixture embeds its complete source recording's SHA-256 hash and original
recording header. All of the player's queued building heads are retained, so
trimming unrelated entities cannot change the housing test. Unused master
fields, sprites, unrelated players and most research states are removed.

Reproduce in the viewer checkout:

```sh
uv run python tools/extract_building_idle_fixture.py /path/to/live-20261111-224438-12.vrec \
  --start 430000 --end 645000 --output tests/fixtures/dan-tc-research-housed.json.gz
uv run python tools/extract_building_idle_fixture.py /path/to/live-20261110-190527-3.vrec \
  --start 240000 --end 260000 --output tests/fixtures/dan-tc-handoff.json.gz
uv run pytest -q tests/test_building_activity.py
```

The other controls explicitly clear queues or change the sample schedule. They
are labelled synthetic controls in the tests and are not evidence about Dan's
game. Full recordings and game assets are not committed.
